1.title: Judge Excludes Key Confession in Sept. 11 Case
1.summary: Prosecutors argued the statements by the defendant, Khalid Shaikh Mohammed, were crucial evidence for the eventual death-penalty trial.

2.title: 'Our parents were crossing the border an hour before the flood hit'
2.summary: Authorities say nearly 2,000 people are missing, including more than 100 Americans and Canadians, as families await word on loved ones after the Nepal flash floods.

3.title: Watch: Puppy rescued from drain using a bucket and cheese
3.summary: The Florida puppy has since been adopted after being turned over to animal control, according to the Tampa Police Department.

4.title: Inside Afghanistan’s Secret Schools for Girls
4.summary: The Taliban have banned education for millions of Afghan girls. Times journalists examined classrooms where students, teachers and parents continue to resist by defying the rules.

5.title: Violence breaks out in Ceuta as migrant crisis continues
5.summary: A group of migrants is accused of throwing stones at a military vehicle, while some locals set fire to their camps on the beach.

6.title: Live Updates: Nepal Roughly Doubles Number of Missing to 1,900 Amid Desperate Search for Survivors
6.summary: A spokeswoman for the disaster relief agency said the tally grew after some 900 people were reported missing from hydropower projects. Rescue efforts were complicated by fears of new possible flooding.
